cores.name: Premium
cores.mechanic: Every card, Deluxe included, gets +r per Deluxe card in the deck.
cores.note: Was 0.15–0.25. Deluxe cards now count at their listed value (the old ×2 base was an NDM convention).

cores.name: Pure
cores.mechanic: Stat or Evolution cards get +r per non-empty, non-Foil card in the deck.
cores.note: Now limited to Stat/Evolution cards as in code.

cores.name: Equilibrium
cores.mechanic: Stat-group cards get +r per distinct colour in the deck (max 4).
cores.note: Now offered on every route, not just Shiny.

cores.name: Shiny
cores.mechanic: Foil cards get +r.

cores.name: Steadfast
cores.mechanic: Stat-group cards get +r.

cores.name: Crimson / Azure / Viridian / Golden
cores.mechanic: Cards of that colour get +r.

cores.name: Void
cores.mechanic: Every card ×(1 + r per empty slot, empty Arcane slots included).

cores.name: Archive
cores.mechanic: Every card gets (1+r)^N − 1, N = Arcane cards in the deck.

cores.name: Empyreal
cores.mechanic: The k best slots (player's choice) get ×(1+r) on a Stat or Evolution card.
cores.note: Now multiplicative, and modeled as the best k slots.

cores.name: Arsenal
cores.mechanic: Offensive cards ×(1+r).

cores.name: Aegis
cores.mechanic: Defensive cards ×(1 + r per orthogonal Defensive neighbour).

cores.name: Tool
cores.mechanic: Utility cards ×(1 + r per other Utility card in the deck).

cores.name: Natural
cores.mechanic: Physical cards get +r.

cores.name: Fae
cores.mechanic: Magical cards get +r.

cores.name: Jupiter
cores.mechanic: Cards with the deck's most common group get +r (Stat excluded, alphabetical tie-break).
cores.note: Greed and Evolution count, so it often lands on Greed cards (which don't score).

cores.name: Pluto
cores.mechanic: Cards with the deck's least common group ×(1+r). Every tag counts, colours don't.

cores.name: Nitwit
cores.mechanic: Arcane slots take regular cards and give them +r; Arcane cards are blocked.

cores.name: Bazaar
cores.mechanic: +r if any of the 8 surrounding cards is a Resource card.

cores.name: Talent
cores.mechanic: +r per surrounding Knack card.
cores.note: Knack cards don't yet grant talent levels in the model.

cores.name: Temporal
cores.mechanic: +r if any card in the 12-cell star-cross is a Temporal card.
cores.note: Unchanged. One 0-value Temporal card feeds up to 12 neighbours.

cores.name: Greed
cores.mechanic: A greed card whose target has 2+ greed cards on it adds +r to its own bonus.

other.name: Construction / Arcane
other.note: Not in this run. In game both place their slots at random; the website lets you place them by hand.

other.name: Adept
other.note: Ability levels on one Arcane slot; no stat effect.

other.name: Harvest / Fortune / Bounty
other.note: Resource-card loot effects; no stat effect.

mods.name: Runic
mods.mechanic: If the mirrored slot holds a same-colour card: ×(1 + 0.2 per shared tag, colour counts). The centre column matches itself.

mods.name: Cake
mods.mechanic: +r per row from the bottom (bottom row +1).

mods.name: Snake
mods.mechanic: +r per card in the same-colour orthogonal chain beyond the first.

mods.name: Cactus
mods.mechanic: Cards that are both Offensive and Defensive get +r.

mods.name: Mutant
mods.mechanic: Stat cards get +r per distinct group in the deck.

mods.name: Puzzle
mods.mechanic: +r per orthogonal neighbour of a different colour.

mods.name: Shadow
mods.mechanic: Built-in Void: every card ×(1 + r per empty slot).

mods.name: Merchant
mods.mechanic: +r per Resource card in the same column.

mods.name: Villager
mods.mechanic: Built-in Nitwit: Arcane slots take regular cards at +r; Arcane cards blocked.

mods.name: Mystery
mods.mechanic: Two random modifiers from the pool, each at 75% strength (×1.75 count, +75% per row, 0.15 per Runic tag).
